This is an assurance evaluation, not an operational autonomy system. The system boundary is explicit: tabletop review only, with synthetic notes, fictional scenarios, no deployment pathway, and no external effects. The review has no live cyber access, no live telemetry, no live sensor feeds, no physical actuators, no real targeting data, and no operational recommendations or operational outputs. It includes full logging, audit trail, deterministic replay of review decisions, human review as oversight rather than containment, deactivation procedure, and kill switch. Data sensitivity is low because no real people or infrastructure are represented. Misuse potential is explicitly considered and bounded by tabletop-only scope. Non-interference with the real world is the top-level assurance claim.
